description: Maps standard story-demo message IDs to the voice line spoken with each displayed message.

Id.simple: Message/text ID that keys the voice mapping.
Id.technical: FName primary key. Show-message commands match this value against the displayed message ID; script preload walks all rows and matches it against the script message IDs in order. Export spells it ID.

Id_Voice.simple: VoiceDataTable row to play for that message.
Id_Voice.technical: FName joined to VoiceDataTable. The command parser resolves it to a Voice row and queues that row's CueSheetName/CueName with the message delay and voice slot; script preload resolves it to add the voice cue sheet to the load set. A missing Voice row leaves no queued voice or cue sheet.

notes: Loaded into DTM.StoryDemoVoiceDataTables (+0x770) from the DataTable primary asset StoryDemoVoiceDataTable.

Selection between standard, short-story and DLC tables is by script context: GameScript_IsDlcScript chooses DLC, script names containing STDM_SS_ choose ShortStoryVoiceDataTable, otherwise this table is used.
The level-sequence message evaluator checks the standard table first and then the DLC table with the same TextId; a later DLC row overwrites the earlier VoiceId.
The export has 2,314 available rows; retail completeness and Blueprint references cannot be asserted from the partial Content tree. Sources are reconstructed retail C++.

usages.detail: Collects standard story voice rows for message parsing.
Preloads the cue sheet of the first matching row.
